/llms.txt.body: # Curate Health - Midtown Discover a unique approach to health and wellness, tailored to meet your individual needs. ## Canonical Site - Website: https://www.curatehealth.ca - Location: 989 Eglinton Ave W, Suite 2, Toronto, ON, M6C 2C6, CA - Phone: 416-900-3311 - Email: hello@curatehealth.ca - Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/SGhuvvWH1C2D2fZB8 - [Contact and directions](https://www.curatehealth.ca/contact): Connect with our healthcare team at Curate Health. Find our location, business hours, and contact information to begin your wellness journey today. ## What Curate Health Offers Curate Health provides Toronto-based healthcare, chiropractic care, rehabilitation, wellness services, lifestyle programming, and cafe/recovery offerings. ## Services - [All services](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services): Clinical care, movement and training, the Recovery Sanctuary and the Curate Lifestyle program, all at Curate Health in Midtown Toronto. - [Clinical Care](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/clinical-care): Restoring function, improving mobility, and empowering you to become the healthiest version of yourself. - [Acupuncture](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/acupuncture): Experience holistic acupuncture treatments designed to support healing, relaxation, and overall body wellness. - [Chiropractic Care](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/chiropractic-care): Chiropractic care at Curate Health in Midtown Toronto. Assessment and hands-on treatment to relieve pain and restore mobility. - [Massage Therapy](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/massage-therapy): Experience personalized massage therapy at Curate Health. Our skilled therapists provide targeted treatments to relieve pain and promote wellness. - [Naturopathy](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/naturopathy): Naturopathic medicine at Curate Health in Midtown Toronto. Natural remedies and evidence-based care to restore balance and vitality. - [Nutritional Counselling](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/nutritional-counselling): Nutritional counselling at Curate Health in Midtown Toronto. Personalized guidance on food and eating, built around your health goals. - [Physiotherapy](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/physiotherapy): Experience expert physiotherapy at Curate Health. Personalized treatments to restore mobility and relieve pain. - [Psychotherapy](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/psychotherapy): Psychotherapy at Curate Health in Midtown Toronto. Personalized support for emotional and mental health, with a registered psychotherapist. - [Movement & Training](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/movement-and-training): Discover the benefits of exercise therapy in improving strength, mobility, and overall well-being through personalized, movement-based care. - [Exercise Rehab](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/exercise-rehab): Discover personalized exercise rehab at Curate Health. Restore mobility, strength, and wellness effectively. - [Fitness Training](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/fitness-training): Discover expert fitness training services at Curate Health. Personalized plans to help you achieve your health and wellness goals. - [Performance Training](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/performance-training): Enhance your strength, endurance, and agility with Curate Health's performance training treatments. - [Recovery Sanctuary](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/recovery-sanctuary): Flowpresso, sauna, cold plunge and yoga therapy in the Recovery Sanctuary, the outdoor space at Curate Health in Midtown Toronto. - [Breathwork](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/recovery-sanctuary/breathwork): Breathwork sessions at Curate Health in Midtown Toronto. Guided breathing practice to settle the nervous system and steady your focus. - [Flowpresso Therapy](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/recovery-sanctuary/flowpresso-therapy): Discover Flowpresso treatment at Curate Health, combining compression, heat, and relaxation for optimal wellness. - [Meditation](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/recovery-sanctuary/meditation): Guided meditation sessions at Curate Health in Midtown Toronto, to build calm and focus as part of your wider care. - [Outdoor Cold Plunge](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/recovery-sanctuary/outdoor-cold-plunge): Revitalize with cold plunge therapy at Curate Health. Reduce inflammation, boost recovery, and enhance wellness with our expert care. - [Outdoor Pilates](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/recovery-sanctuary/outdoor-pilates): Mat Pilates in the Recovery Sanctuary at Curate Health in Midtown Toronto. Small outdoor classes of up to 12, and one-on-one sessions, at any level. - [Outdoor Sauna](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/recovery-sanctuary/outdoor-sauna): Experience the rejuvenating benefits of outdoor sauna treatments at Curate Health. Relax, detoxify, and unwind. - [Outdoor Yoga Therapy](https://www.curatehealth.ca/services/recovery-sanctuary/outdoor-yoga-therapy): Experience outdoor yoga therapy at Curate Health. Connect with nature, improve flexibility, and find inner peace. ## Programs - [Our Programs](https://www.curatehealth.ca/our-programs): Structured health programs at Curate Health in Midtown Toronto, built around lasting change rather than short term results. - [Curate Lifestyle](https://www.curatehealth.ca/our-programs/curate-lifestyle): The Curate Lifestyle program at Curate Health in Midtown Toronto. Group and one-to-one care addressing the root causes of chronic conditions. - [Curate Lifestyle Program](https://www.curatehealth.ca/our-programs/curate-lifestyle-program): Curate Lifestyle Program ## Products - [Products](https://www.curatehealth.ca/products): Custom foot orthotics, knee braces, compression stockings, TENS machines and professional grade supplements, fitted at Curate Health in Midtown Toronto. - [Compression Stockings](https://www.curatehealth.ca/products/compression-stockings): Discover premium compression stockings at Curate Health. Designed for comfort and support to improve circulation and relieve swelling. - [Custom Foot Orthotics](https://www.curatehealth.ca/products/custom-foot-orthotics): Discover custom foot orthotics at Curate Health. Designed for comfort, support, and improved mobility. Perfect for your unique needs. - [Custom Knee Braces](https://www.curatehealth.ca/products/custom-knee-braces): Discover custom knee braces at Curate Health, designed for support, stability, and comfort during recovery and activity. - [Professional Grade Supplements](https://www.curatehealth.ca/products/professional-grade-supplements): Professional grade supplements at Curate Health in Midtown Toronto, selected for quality and available through our practitioners. - [TENS Machines](https://www.curatehealth.ca/products/tens-machines): Explore TENS machines at Curate Health for effective pain relief. Portable, easy-to-use devices for managing muscle and nerve pain. ## Cafe And Recovery - [Curate Cafe](https://www.curatehealth.ca/cafe): A space where nourishment meets intention. - [Cafe Menu](https://www.curatehealth.ca/cafe/menu): The full menu at Curate Cafe in Midtown Toronto: matcha, pour-over coffee, kombucha on tap, smoothies, salads and house-made energy bars, with ingredients. - Menu as a PDF: https://cdn.sanity.io/files/rwc5kyvy/production/150d700144f42ec82a9d996ac6e2da2e8c74a095.pdf ## About - [About Curate Health](https://www.curatehealth.ca/about): An interdisciplinary health and wellness space in Midtown Toronto.
